name: NileCAM56

sources.title: NileCAM56 - 5MP IMX568 Global shutter GMSL2 Camera (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor (Sony Pregius S IMX568), shutter, chroma, optical format, pixel size, active and array size, FOV with e-con's lens, holder, frame rate, output, interface, operating voltage, size (l x b)

note: A colour global-shutter GMSL2 camera module (M12 holder); FOV 113 (D) x 85.64 (H) x 72.25 (V) degrees "with the lens provided by e-con". The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Frame rate "5MP @ 90 fps", uncompressed NV12; the stream size of the "5MP" mode is not stated, so no stream is entered (active area 2472 x 2064, array 2472 x 2128). The page notes the module "Doesn't come with default firmware". Power "TBD" (null); mass not stated (null); size_mm null (only "l x b" 30 x 30 mm). Not stated: f-number, focal length, distortion.
